conventions.data_kind: Known-factor Gaussian simulation, not market or replication evidence.
conventions.estimation_frequency: Weekly Wednesday log returns. EWMA span 52; factor regressions use the same weekly data and span. Vol normalization affects asset/factor covariance only.
conventions.missing_data: Complete simulated panel; no imputation or asset filtering.
conventions.observation_frequency: Business-day Gaussian increments interpreted as log returns.
conventions.rebalance_frequency: Shared EWMA quarterly schedule mapped to observed Wednesdays. All estimators fit current covariances on these exact truncated dates.
conventions.sharpe_convention: qis SharpeConvention.PA with zero risk-free rate; all portfolios are net. Compounded annual return / weekly annualized volatility.
conventions.transaction_costs: 10 bp on gross traded notional, including entry; no funding or management fee.
conventions.warmup: History from 2023-01-02; at least 52 weekly observations before each fit.

registry.description: Coverage ledger for six offline teaching previews in the README and analytics gallery. All four producer families are implemented; publication requires complete-bundle validation and a separate visual-review record.

conventions.data_kind: Known-factor Gaussian simulation, not market or replication evidence.
conventions.estimation_frequency: Weekly Wednesday log returns. EWMA span 52; factor regressions use the same weekly data and span. Vol normalization affects asset/factor covariance only.
conventions.missing_data: Complete simulated panel; no imputation or asset filtering.
conventions.observation_frequency: Business-day Gaussian increments interpreted as log returns.
conventions.rebalance_frequency: Shared EWMA quarterly schedule mapped to observed Wednesdays. All estimators fit current covariances on these exact truncated dates.
conventions.sharpe_convention: qis SharpeConvention.PA with zero risk-free rate; all portfolios are net. Compounded annual return / weekly annualized volatility.
conventions.transaction_costs: 10 bp on gross traded notional, including entry; no funding or management fee.
conventions.warmup: History from 2023-01-02; at least 52 weekly observations before each fit.
